name: dsh-llm-wiretap
description: Read-only raw-stream recorder for DeepSeek Harness: intercepts POST streaming Messages/Completions requests through globalThis.fetch, records the exact request body (sampling parameters) and the untouched upstream SSE bytes, and reports the same line-repetition statistics as dsh-degen-guard so a degeneration loop can be attributed to the provider stream or to DSH's own assembly.
author: MacilyDots
